description: Dry-run a `data` payload against a template's JSON Schema and get back exactly the errors a render would raise — field path, expected type, what was received and a value that would be accepted. Costs nothing and renders nothing. Use it before a batch, or whenever you are assembling a payload from somewhere you do not control. `warnings` lists fields the template would not use, each with a `did_you_mean` where there is a near match, and, where the template's schema declares `lang`, what `data.lang` would do.

data.description: The payload you intend to render. Checked against the template's JSON Schema; fields it does not use come back in `warnings`, not as errors. `lang` and `labels` at the root are honoured only if the template's schema declares them (check get_template); otherwise they are ordinary unknown fields.

template.description: Template to use: `invoice` for the latest version, or `invoice@3` to pin version 3. Pin the version in anything you ship — a new version changes the output and the cache key. Call list_templates to see what this account has.

name: validate_data
title: Validate a payload against a template
